description: Objective: remove the concrete Windows runtime failures behind nightly t3:windows (#2568/#2964) and PR #3548's collection error without adding baseline debt. PR #3543 moved `import fcntl` out of `tests/unit/scripts/oracle_reviewers/test_local_review.py`, but line 12 still imports `_project/scripts/oracle_reviewers/local.py`, which runs `import fcntl` at module top level (line 5). When `test_local_review.py` is passed as an explicit path (or collected on Windows), collection fails with `ModuleNotFoundError: No module named 'fcntl'`. Separately, four scripts decode `git -z` or `git show` output with `text=True` and no `encoding`, using the locale encoding (cp1252 on Windows, where byte 0x9d from UTF-8 smart quotes raises `UnicodeDecodeError`): `scripts/doc_reference_inventory.py:47`, `_project/scripts/inert_paths.py:322`, `scripts/heavy_tier_needed.py:73-92`, and `_project/scripts/oracle_reviewers/local.py:105`. Prior art: extends `scripts/sqlglot_fork_diff.py` (#3481, `encoding='utf-8'`) and `#3543`'s lazy POSIX import pattern.
